g.text: Upload it nine times, not once.
SAME EDIT · NEW VOICE · NINE LANGUAGES

svg.text: One finished video centre (EN). Eight copies fan out around it (DE FR ES PT IT PL ID
DA), the exact nine on brew's site. Same picture in every copy; only the waveform
Copies clone out of the centre player along radial paths, 50ms stagger. Each waveform
re-draws in a new shape while the picture stays locked.
"And when a video works, upload it nine times, not once."
One phrase of VO repeated, cross-fading through languages.
All nine stack into a film strip.

g.text: SHOT 26 — THE THUMBNAIL, DRAWN BY A PERSON

svg.text: The thumbnail, drawn by a person
A film strip of frames from the actual video. The brackets pick one real frame; it
lifts out and type is set over it by hand: "PANAMA RAN DRY". Label: DRAWN BY A PERSON.
Strip scrolls R→L, decelerates; brackets snap to frame 3; frame lifts (shadow grows)
and scales to the thumbnail canvas. Type slams in, 2 words.
"Even the thumbnail is drawn by a person."
Strip whir slowing to a stop; pen-tablet scribble; stamp.
Thumbnail slides away; the old loop ghosts back in.

g.text: SHOT 27 — THE LOOP, ONE LAST TIME

svg.text: The Act I loop ghosts back in, grey, then collapses into a single green button: "Send
us a script →" (brew's real CTA). The cursor clicks it.
Ring cards fall inward and dissolve into the button (gravity well). Click: button
Reverse of the Act I notification cluster, sucked into one click.
Button blooms into the finished file.
One finished file: panama-canal_final.mp4 · 58:24 · 1080p · READY TO UPLOAD, with a
single Approve button. Super, two lines: "You approve." / "You don't assemble."
File card rises; "You approve." types on; cursor clicks Approve (check fills); "You
don't assemble." lands on the click.
One clean click; the brew signature begins.
Card flips to the end card.
